prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add an `export-json` command requiring `--path` and accepting optional `--status pending|completed`. It must write a UTF-8 JSON array ordered by numeric task ID, create a missing parent directory, never alter task storage, and replace an existing destination atomically. Return a stable text or `--json` summary containing exported count and destination. Reject an invalid status without creating or changing the destination. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/export.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON exports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `EXPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+function Write-JsonArrayAtomically {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Values
+    )
+
+    $fullPath = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
+    $parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($fullPath)
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
+        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
+    }
+
+    $temporary = Join-Path $parent ".$([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($fullPath)).$([guid]::NewGuid()).tmp"
+    try {
+        $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($Values) -Depth 8
+        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary, "$json`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+        [System.IO.File]::Move($temporary, $fullPath, $true)
+    }
+    finally {
+        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporary) {
+            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force
+        }
+    }
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/export.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $fixtureTasks = @(
        [ordered]@{ id = 10; title = 'Tenth'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-01-10T00:00:00Z' }
        [ordered]@{ id = 2; title = 'Second'; description = ''; status = 'completed'; createdAt = '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z' }
        [ordered]@{ id = 1; title = 'First'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' }
    )
    $fixtureJson = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $fixtureTasks -Depth 8
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($dataFile, "$fixtureJson`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $storeBeforeExport = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile)

    $exportFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'missing/parent/all.json'
    $export = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportFile, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($export.ExitCode -eq 0) 'export-json should succeed'
    $exportSummary = $export.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($exportSummary.exportedCount -eq 3 -and $exportSummary.destination -eq $exportFile) 'JSON summary should report count and destination'
    $exported = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportFile -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($exported.id -join ',') -eq '1,2,10') 'export-json should order tasks by numeric ID'
    $exportBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($exportFile)
    $hasUtf8Bom = $exportBytes.Count -ge 3 -and $exportBytes[0] -eq 239 -and $exportBytes[1] -eq 187 -and $exportBytes[2] -eq 191
    Assert-True (-not $hasUtf8Bom) 'export-json should write UTF-8 without a BOM'
    Assert-True ([System.Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual($storeBeforeExport, [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile))) 'export-json should not alter task storage'
    Assert-True (-not $export.Output.Contains('EXPORT')) 'JSON summary should not include the banner'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($exportFile, 'old destination', [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $filtered = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportFile, '--status', 'pending', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($filtered.ExitCode -eq 0) 'filtered export-json should replace an existing destination'
    $filteredTasks = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportFile -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($filteredTasks.id -join ',') -eq '1,10') 'status filtering should export only matching tasks in numeric order'
    Assert-True (@($filtered.Output.Split("`n") | Where-Object { $_ -eq '#########EXPORT#####' }).Count -eq 1) 'text export should display the banner once'
    Assert-True ($filtered.Output.Contains("Exported 2 task(s) to $exportFile")) 'text summary should report count and destination'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($exportFile, 'keep destination', [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $invalidStatus = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportFile, '--status', 'blocked', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidStatus.ExitCode -ne 0 -and (Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportFile -Raw) -eq 'keep destination') 'invalid status should not change an existing destination'
    $missingInvalidPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid/new.json'
    $invalidMissing = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $missingInvalidPath, '--status', 'blocked', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidMissing.ExitCode -ne 0 -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $missingInvalidPath)) 'invalid status should not create a destination'
    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0) 'export-json should require --path'
    $samePath = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $dataFile, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($samePath.ExitCode -ne 0 -and [System.Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual($storeBeforeExport, [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile))) 'export-json should reject the task storage path'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerFile)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes)
    $bannerLines = @($bannerText.TrimEnd("`r", "`n") -split "`r?`n")
    Assert-True ($bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and ($bannerBytes.Count -lt 2 -or $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10)) 'banner should end with exactly one newline'
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 })) 'banner lines should satisfy width constraints'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.Contains('EXPORT') -and $bannerText -match '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#\(\):=\-\r\n]+$') 'banner should contain EXPORT and only allowed ASCII characters'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' })) 'banner should not have trailing whitespace'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($dataFile, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($fixtureTasks[0]) -Depth 8), [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -ne 0) 'remove should still reject an unknown task'
    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '10', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 10) 'remove should still remove and report a stored task'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
